# PM.

> Personal design/dev portfolio for Pranjal ("PM."). Brutalist × glassmorphism visual identity. Single-page site: hero, skills & frameworks, selected works, about/manifesto, contact.

PM. designs and builds digital products — UI design, design systems, and front-end implementation (React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion). This file is a machine-readable summary for AI agents and LLMs, per the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org). A human-readable version of the same information is at /agents.

## Site

- [Home](/): Hero, Skills & Frameworks, Selected Works, About/Manifesto, Contact.
- [Agents page](/agents): Human-readable version of this file, for AI agents/crawlers and curious visitors.

## Skills & frameworks

See the "Skills & Frameworks" section on the home page for the current list (languages, frameworks, tooling, design). Content there is the source of truth; do not assume this file is kept in sync with it.

## Selected works

See the "Selected Works" section on the home page. As of this writing it includes Streamera (streaming platform UI) and RSSible (RSS platform), plus placeholder entries for upcoming projects.

## Contact

Social links (Github, LinkedIn, Behance) are in the site footer and the Contact overlay. This file intentionally omits specific handles/emails to avoid them going stale — read the live page.

## Notes for crawlers

- This is a client-rendered single-page app (Vite + React). Content is not present in the initial HTML response; render JavaScript to read section content, or rely on this file and /agents for a summary.
- robots.txt allows crawling of the whole site.
